Privacy notice.

How consultation information and calculator selections are handled on antblu.net.

Consultation requests

The consultation form sends your name, email, project description, and any optional fields you provide to Anthony Bluemel’s support inbox. This information is used to respond and scope your request. Basic connection details may appear in hosting or support logs used for site operation and abuse prevention.

You can email antblu@antblu.net to ask about your inquiry or request correction or removal of the details you provided.

Browser storage and external services

Application selections and a prepared quote summary can be stored for the current browser tab. You choose whether to include them in a consultation. Theme preference can be stored across visits. The site loads fonts from Google Fonts. Vendor websites, public sandboxes and any scheduling link follow their own privacy terms.
